::: {.research-intro}
David's research draws on education policy and economics. Using large administrative datasets and, where possible, experimental or quasi-experimental designs, he studies what makes teaching effective and how policy can help schools recruit, develop, and keep a strong and racially diverse teaching workforce.

::: {.brief-note}
**Short on time?** Shorter, plain-language versions of many of these studies are available from the [Maryland Equity Project](https://education.umd.edu/research/centers/mep) and the [Maryland Longitudinal Data System Center](https://mldscenter.maryland.gov/Research&ReportingSummaries.html).
:::
:::

<script>
(function () {
var dlg = document.querySelector('.card-viewer');
var img = dlg.querySelector('img'), cap = dlg.querySelector('.card-viewer-caption');
document.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
var a = e.target.closest('a.card-zoom');
if (!a || !dlg.showModal) return;
e.preventDefault();
var f = a.closest('.paper').querySelector('.paper-finding');
img.src = a.getAttribute('href');
img.alt = f ? f.textContent : '';
cap.textContent = f ? f.textContent : '';
dlg.showModal();
});
dlg.addEventListener('click', function (e) { if (e.target === dlg || e.target.closest('.card-viewer-close')) dlg.close(); });
})();
</script>

<script>
// Research page: order papers by date or by topic, and filter by topic (2026-11-12).
// Without JavaScript the page shows every paper, newest first.
(function () {
var AREAS = [["workforce", "Teacher labor markets and educator diversity"], ["development", "Coaching, evaluation, and teacher development"], ["teaching", "Effective teaching and its effects on students"], ["resources", "Policy, resources, and student opportunity"], ["early", "Earlier work: Teaching English"]];
var controls = document.querySelector('.research-controls');
var pubList = document.querySelector('#listing-published .paper-list');
if (!controls || !pubList) return;
controls.hidden = false;
var host = pubList.parentNode;
var papers = Array.prototype.slice.call(pubList.children); // newest first
var view = 'recent', area = 'all', topicWrap = null;
function render() {
  if (view === 'recent') {
    if (topicWrap) { topicWrap.remove(); topicWrap = null; }
    papers.forEach(function (p) { pubList.appendChild(p); });
    pubList.hidden = false;
  } else {
    pubList.hidden = true;
    if (!topicWrap) {
      topicWrap = document.createElement('div');
      AREAS.forEach(function (a) {
        var items = papers.filter(function (p) { return p.dataset.area === a[0]; });
        if (!items.length) return;
        var h = document.createElement('h3');
        h.className = 'topic-head'; h.id = 'topic-' + a[0]; h.dataset.area = a[0]; h.textContent = a[1];
        var ul = document.createElement('ul'); ul.className = 'paper-list'; ul.dataset.area = a[0];
        items.forEach(function (p) { ul.appendChild(p); });
        topicWrap.appendChild(h); topicWrap.appendChild(ul);
      });
      host.appendChild(topicWrap);
    }
  }
  document.querySelectorAll('.paper').forEach(function (p) { p.hidden = area !== 'all' && p.dataset.area !== area; });
  if (topicWrap) topicWrap.querySelectorAll('[data-area]').forEach(function (el) { el.hidden = area !== 'all' && el.dataset.area !== area; });
  var wp = document.getElementById('working-papers-section');
  if (wp) { var any = wp.querySelector('.paper:not([hidden])'); wp.hidden = !any; var hr = wp.nextElementSibling; if (hr && hr.tagName === 'HR') hr.hidden = !any; }
  controls.querySelectorAll('[data-view]').forEach(function (b) { b.setAttribute('aria-pressed', b.dataset.view === view); });
  controls.querySelectorAll('[data-area]').forEach(function (b) { b.setAttribute('aria-pressed', b.dataset.area === area); });
}
controls.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
  var b = e.target.closest('button'); if (!b) return;
  if (b.dataset.view) view = b.dataset.view;
  if (b.dataset.area) area = b.dataset.area;
  render();
});
// a topic tag on a paper shows just that topic
document.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
  var t = e.target.closest('.paper-tag'); if (!t) return;
  e.preventDefault(); area = t.dataset.area; render();
  controls.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', block: 'start' });
});
})();
</script>
